speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing sudden-onset vertigo; to help you, please describe exactly what you feel when the spinning sensation starts, such as whether it feels like the room is spinning or if you just feel off-balance, and how long each episode lasts. Also, have you noticed any associated symptoms like hearing loss, ringing in your ears, nausea, or any weakness or double vision?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).
